title: A direct request and expected initiative

captions.physics: Combining a request with named expectation
captions.energy: Clarifying a binding condition of attention

meaning: You can combine a direct request with admitting expected initiative and preserve gentle steadiness without turning attention into a test of guessing.
text: Temperance in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in joining a direct request with acknowledgement of your expectation. The Devil in energy supports honest clarification of a binding condition: whether only unprompted attention counts as genuine. Strength in emotions brings gentle steadiness. You can want initiative and speak directly about a need now; asking does not devalue future free interest, while expectation makes no obligation to guess.

For example, you say you wanted a question about an important event and also acknowledge waiting for it without a reminder. **Naming a request does not make attention unreal**. You can describe what happened and hear a living response. Gentle steadiness helps avoid rejecting it merely because the occasion was already named. Yet wanting initiative remains a legitimate conversational subject; it need neither be hidden nor become a compulsory phrase the other person must deliver exactly.

Pressure becomes quiet if calm hides the earlier test continuing: now a sufficiently correct question must be asked. Request and expectation then combine only outwardly while the answer is still examined. The Devil’s constructive honesty helps notice the condition without accusation. You can directly discuss interest and hear its different forms; steadiness requires neither abandoning the wish nor confirming a duty to keep guessing what is needed for you both.
